items.difficulty_reason: The proof verifies all four weak Serre conditions with real work in (3) and (4): kernels are produced through the $g_!$-$g^*$ transport (shriek pushforward quasi-coherent, cokernel quasi-coherent on $\mathcal{X}$, exactness of $g^*$, and the LQCoh^{fbc} membership of kernels via the base-change proposition), and the extension argument lifts a presentation of $\mathcal{G}$ through the vanishing of $H^1$ assembled from three cited results, finishing with a presentation of $\mathcal{E}$.
